snapshots.aria: Save a snapshot of the current config now
badge.title: Auto-snapshot status; click to open
err.busy: A session is running (agent in progress). Undo/redo would interrupt every session; wait for the task to finish or interrupt it first, then retry.
keys.hint: Click the box then press a combo; Backspace clears; defaults Ctrl+Alt+Z / Ctrl+Alt+Y
panel.title: Snapshot Manager
panel.diff.title: Diff preview
export.sensitive.warn: ⚠️ This archive contains REAL secrets (.env / .credentials.yaml in keep mode or legacy snapshots) — do NOT share it!
boot.alert: ⚠️ Previous DSH run exited abnormally — roll back to the last good state
boot.crash.session: Likely session-file damage — run undo_scan (quarantine=true) in chat/CLI, or offline dsh-undo.ps1 scan --fix
boot.crash.bundle: Likely a profile-bundle hard-check failure — enable SAFE MODE and restart DSH
boot.crash.patch: Likely a plugin mount/load failure — roll back to a recent good snapshot
boot.rollback: Roll back to last good state
restart.required: Rolled back. A DSH restart is required for the restored state to take effect.
safe.on.confirm: Enable SAFE MODE? All user plugins except the undo system will be temporarily disabled, and profile bundles that would prevent DSH from booting will be neutralized (a snapshot and config backups are taken first). Takes effect after a DSH restart.
safe.off.confirm: Exit SAFE MODE? The full plugin set from before safe mode will be restored. Takes effect after a DSH restart.
settings.cleanupNote: Auto keeps {keepAuto}, pre-restore keeps {keepPre}; manual snapshots are never deleted; disabling auto-cleanup keeps everything
panel.empty: No snapshots yet. Config changes auto-archive; or click Save now.
panel.confirm.restore: Restore to this snapshot? Current state is kept as a redo point.
panel.confirm.delete: Delete this snapshot? This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Snapshot Settings
settings.sensitive.redact: Redact (default: values become ***REDACTED***, local rollback restores fully)
crash.session: Likely session-file damage caused the boot crash — run undo_scan (quarantine=true) to scan/repair.
crash.bundle: Likely a profile-bundle hard-check failure — undo_safe_mode action "on" neutralizes the broken entries; enter it and restart.
crash.patch: Likely a plugin mount/load failure — enter undo_safe_mode action "on" and restart.
safe.on: Safe mode ON (pre-snapshot {id}). Restart DSH to boot with only dsh-undo-savepoint.
safe.rescan.found: Rescan found {n} bundle entries that would crash the boot: {list}.
safe.rescan.none: Rescan found no new broken bundle entries.
safe.neutralized: Neutralized {n} bundle entries that would crash the boot: {list}.
safe.patchNote: Note: dsh-session-persistence-jsonl is missing {n} tolerance patch(es) ({list}); session damage may still crash the boot — run tools/apply-dsh-patches.ps1 apply offline.
safe.stale: Safe mode state belongs to another home/profile (stale); treated as OFF. You can enter safe mode again for the current home.
safe.off: Safe mode OFF. Restart DSH to load all plugins again.
safe.off.restorePkg: Restored profile package.json ({n} neutralized bundle entr(ies) restored).
safe.off.legacy: Legacy state: only patch restored; package.json untouched.
safe.err.corruptPkg: profile package.json could not be parsed; bundle neutralization skipped: {msg}; restore a snapshot first (undo_restore).
safe.err.backupWrite: Safe-mode backup write failed ({backup}). Refusing to enter safe mode.
undo.alreadyMatches: Current config already matches every undoable snapshot — no real change since the last snapshot, so there is nothing to undo.
undo.redoBlocked: redo blocked: newer changes exist after the undo
restore.needsRestart: NOTE: a restart of DSH is required for the restored state to take effect.
restore.depsHint: Restored config files are in place; re-run with sync_deps=true to rebuild dependencies automatically.
restore.preflightMissing: ⚠️ Cross-machine preflight: referenced but NOT resolvable on this machine: {missing}
restore.preflightHint: DSH may fail to start after restore — install them first, or use undo_safe_mode action "on" to boot with only the undo system.
snap.created: Manual snapshot {id} created ({n} file(s), reason: {reason}). Store: {dir}
list.empty: No snapshots yet. They appear automatically when config files change.
diff.notFound: Snapshot not found: {id}. Run undo_list first.
diff.title: Diff of {id} vs current:
restore.unknownMode: undo_restore: unknown mode "{mode}" (use undo | redo | id)
prune.disabled: Auto-cleanup is disabled in settings — no snapshots were deleted.
prune.done: Pruned {a} auto/baseline and {p} pre-restore snapshot(s){blobs}. Auto keeps {keepAuto}, pre-restore keeps {keepPre}.
export.warn: ⚠️ WARNING: this archive contains REAL secrets (.env / .credentials.yaml in keep mode or legacy snapshots) — do NOT share it.
doctor.head: Diagnostic ({level}): ✅ {ok} healthy, ⚠️ {warn} warnings, ❌ {err} errors.
doctor.canFix: 🔧 {n} check(s) can be auto-repaired: call undo_doctor with fix=true, or run dsh-undo.ps1 doctor -Fix offline
msg.none: No message-level file-change batches recorded yet.
msg.undone: Rolled back batch {id} (msg {msg}): restored {c} files, deleted {d} new files, {m} missing, {n} skipped.
msg.title: Message-level undo
settings.schedule.hint: Auto-snapshot on a timer, interval ≥1 min; disabled means only config changes auto-snapshot
settings.workspaceDirs.hint: Comma/semicolon separated (multi-select); when non-empty it REPLACES the default current-dir scope; leave empty = current dir only
compact.none: No orphan blobs — nothing to clean.
